title: Find your next chapter.
intro: Independent sellers. Remarkable watches. Explore what is available in Lebanon today.
searchPlaceholder: A watch, a reference, a story…
moneyHelp: Enter US dollars, for example 1250.50. Arabic digits are welcome.
rangeError: Enter a valid US dollar amount with at most two decimal places and a minimum no greater than the maximum.
emptyBody: Try a wider price range or fewer filters. Only currently published, available watches appear here.
saveHelp: Bookmark or copy this URL to revisit these exact filters. Saved-search alerts are not available yet.
copyFailed: Copy the address from your browser to keep this search.
unavailableBody: We could not confirm current availability. Nothing has been purchased or reserved. Please try again.
notModified: Seller declares no modified parts. This is not an originality guarantee.
modified: Seller declares modified parts. Review the disclosure before proceeding.
historyUnavailable: Seller history is unavailable. Try again when the source is available.
officialBody: This business was onboarded by the platform. This is business assurance, not an independent inspection of this watch.
officialUnknownBody: Business onboarding could not be confirmed. No independent inspection result is implied.
privateBody: Independent inspection applies to private-seller watches. No result is implied before a recorded inspection.
listingUnavailable: This watch is not available to view.
listingUnavailableBody: The reference may be private, withdrawn or no longer published. Private documents are never shown here.
reconnecting: Reconnecting · displayed prices may be out of date
offline: Offline · bids and purchases cannot be confirmed
notStarted: No auction has been opened for this watch.
auctionUnavailable: Live auction data is unavailable. Do not rely on a previously displayed price.
openingPrice: Opening bid · no public bid yet
elapsed: Scheduled end reached · awaiting server confirmation
masked: Bidder identities are masked. Private maximum bids are never displayed.
latestHistory: Showing public bids in the current bounded sequence window; earlier history is not included.
emptyHistoryWindow: No public bids in this sequence window. Earlier bids may exist; private maximum changes do not create public bids.
actionsUnavailable: Sale actions appear here when the relevant service is available. A displayed price is not a purchase confirmation.
slotUnavailable: This sale action is temporarily unavailable.
invalidCursor: This search page has expired or its filters changed. Return to the first page.
compareHelp: Choose up to three public watches. Availability is checked again while comparing.
similarBasis: Matching uses the same brand among the first available search results.
noSimilar: No matching watches in the current results.
totalUnavailable: The total matching count is unavailable.
sellerUnavailable: Public seller information is unavailable. Return to the watch or try again.
deniedBody: You do not currently have permission to view this information. Return to public watches or try again after your access changes.
allSimilar: See all watches from this brand
